split: For test year Y, forest entries 2012..Y-3 with outcomes strictly before Y-2-01-01; calibration entries Y-2..Y-1 with outcomes before Y-01-01; test entries Y, outcomes bounded by 2026-09-03; every follow-up capped at 12 calendar months.
population: Inherited all nonfinancial observed-first financial/audit ST or *ST; announcement dates; 75 unchanged inputs
calibration: Joint IPCW Brier of two causes; four parameters c1,c2,b1,b2; a_k(t)=c_k*g_k(t); g from forest-training AJ normalized at day 365 and held constant thereafter; no intermediate-time calibration claim
constraints: c>=0, b>=1e-6, sum(c)+b_k<=1 for each k; globally valid for every original probability simplex point; no clipping
solver: Convex 4-parameter QP; enumerate 57 active sets (<=4 of 6 linear inequalities), solve KKT with least squares, independently certify linear-program Frank-Wolfe gap<=1e-8 and primal feasibility<=1e-10; no objective relaxation.
primary: Fixed equal three-seed prediction ensemble, calibrated ONCE as an ensemble; compare identical ensemble before/after. Also retain all individual-seed before/after results.
uncertainty: Seed ranges descriptive; no confidence claims or bootstrap tuning
evaluation: 12-month IPCW AUC AP Brier, mean risk, incidence, Top20/25 and 3/6 month lead, full curve simplex/monotonicity and q2 exact function reconstruction
limits: PROVISIONAL original financial and industry vintages
Same-day annual reports excluded under unchanged announcement origin
2023 calibration has one termination; scarce calibration support
Only fixed 12m calibration; time shape is prescribed
Rank and structural stability are unchanged by positive affine calibration
base_hyperparameters: Unchanged 32 trees depth6 min_leaf10 min_events3 min_groups5; q2 shared quantiles and 25 eligible features per tree; all prior seeds and cause weights (1,1) retained
resources: Existing two-node Slurm physical pool, NFS, one thread per task, 4GiB RLIMIT_AS; no GPU
privacy: Company rows, predictions, calibrator/forest coefficients, thresholds, function values stay server
